headline: African Debt: AfDB and ALSF Tackle the Extra Cost of Sovereign Financing
summary: The African Development Bank and ALSF officially launched the African Sovereign Credit Rating Initiative in Abidjan on 23 and 24 November. The programme aims to strengthen African states' dealings with rating agencies.
why: The African Development Bank is a multilateral lender financing infrastructure and development across Africa, and sovereign ratings affect African borrowing costs.
original_headline: Dette africaine : la BAD et l’ALSF s’attaquent au surcoût du financement souverain
